benchmark.intended_decision: Compare maintenance scheduling policies on a bounded synthetic finite-buffer production line.
benchmark.purpose: Contract fixture only. No physical plant, field performance, predictive superiority or production qualification is represented.

task.estimand: Paired difference in good-unit output and simulated downtime over a fixed synthetic horizon between the candidate policy and a reactive baseline.
task.system_boundary: One synthetic asynchronous production line containing three machines, finite intermediate buffers and a single maintenance resource.
task.time_support: Synthetic 30-day simulated horizon with one-hour decision intervals.
task.spatial_support: Single synthetic production line; no geographic interpretation.
task.output_contract: Per-replication good units, downtime, repair hours, rejected units and all declared protected-constraint outcomes.
known_exclusions: No stochastic model calibration to a real facility
No labor-law, safety-case or regulatory assessment

datasets.license_or_basis: Generated synthetic fixture owned by this repository; not a third-party dataset.
datasets.notes: Placeholder digest identifies the illustrative fixture contract shape only; replace with computed bytes digest before a real run.

split_plan.split_semantics: Synthetic machine identities machine-a and machine-b are training groups; machine-c is the held-out test group. The split manifest is illustrative, not a real dataset split.

comparability.rationale: Illustrative fixture declares identical task, information, tuning, compute and physical-resource boundaries; it does not establish actual comparator equivalence.

physical_resource_budgets.scope: Per method over the synthetic 30-day simulation horizon.
Per method over the synthetic 30-day simulation horizon.

budgets.equal_budget_policy: Each method receives the same declared observation stream, tuning wall time, execution wall time, CPU budget, peak memory and simulated maintenance resources.

metrics.name: Good units produced
metrics.definition: Count of units accepted by the synthetic quality predicate over the full horizon.

metrics.name: Unplanned downtime
metrics.definition: Sum of machine-unavailable hours attributed to unplanned failure events.
metrics.denominator: Three machines over one 30-day synthetic horizon per replication.

metrics.name: Maintenance resource hours
metrics.definition: Technician hours consumed by maintenance interventions.

protected_constraints.scope: All produced units in each replication; no quality compensation by throughput.
protected_constraints.rationale: Synthetic fixture floor only; not an industrial product specification.
No real workers, equipment or physical actuation exist in this synthetic fixture.

replication.stopping_rule: Complete one fixed 30-day simulated horizon; no early stopping.

environment.runtime: Rust stable (version to be pinned for executable run)
environment.notes: Synthetic schema fixture; actual host/compiler/container digest must be frozen before running.
